## About
Next Level Car Care is an auto repair and maintenance shop on Shaver St in Pasadena. We handle the regular stuff like oil changes, alignments and brakes, plus the repairs that come up in between.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 67 reviews. One customer said we were very transparent about what they were spending and what we fixed. Another said we kept them updated and explained everything clearly, without the usual runaround.
We're open Monday through Saturday, and you can drop your car off after hours when that works better for you.

## Services
- Oil Change: Regular oil changes to help protect your engine. One customer had an oil change, alignment, tire rotation and balance done in one visit.
- Wheel Alignment: Alignments, plus wheel balancing, so your car tracks straight and your tires wear evenly.
- Brake Repair and Replacement: Brake service and repair to help keep you and your passengers safe.
- Air Conditioning A/C Repair: A/C service and repair for the Pasadena heat.
- Tire Repair and Replacement: Tire repairs and new tires when it's time.
- Steering and Suspension Work: Front end work like struts, shocks, tie rod ends, ball joints and springs.
- Starting and Charging Repair: Help for cars that won't crank or start.
- Engine Cooling System Flush & Repair: Cooling system flushes and repairs to keep your engine running right.

## FAQ
Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. You can drop off your vehicle 24/7.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 1-713-485-6700 or fill out the appointment form with your info and the services you need. The date and time you ask for may not be available, so we'll confirm with you.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: Yes. We do front end mechanical repairs for all makes and models, no matter the cause.
